settings.question: Will it put a hole in my sweater?
settings.answer: Not when used as directed. The stainless guard is rigid, so it doesn't flex into the fabric, and the blades sit behind it. Use the higher setting on fine knits, glide without pressing, and keep the fabric flat. If anything goes wrong, our 30-day return covers you.

settings.question: Does it work on cashmere and merino?
settings.answer: Yes. Use the [higher] height setting and light, small circles. Test on an inside seam first.

settings.question: How long does the battery last?
settings.answer: About [90 minutes] per charge, enough for [15+] sweaters. It charges with any USB-C cable in about [2 hours].

settings.question: Isn't a $15 shaver the same thing?
settings.answer: Cheap shavers usually run on AA batteries, have a flexible guard and a tiny lint bin. That's where holes, dead batteries and constant emptying come from. Lastly is built to fix those three things.
